The '''Coruscant Financial Exchange Establishment Act''' was a law passed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the year [[3985 BBY]]<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> that established the [[Coruscant Financial Exchange]].
